text:
Ana: quick sync—drafting a tight private-preview plan for design partners. Target: 8 companies, 2 waves, 6 weeks. Need ops + CS + research sign-off on recruitment filters and success metrics.

Kevin: 2 waves makes sense. Recommend wave sizes 3/5 to stress test docs earlier. SDK quickstart must be <20m.

Maya: onboarding UX checklist: API key flow, consent for telemetry, example prompts, toggles for streaming. Tiny friction = lost signal.

Jonah: recruit customers already on hosted inference or with hard latency SLAs. Require a named engineer contact and agreement to provide ~50 prompts.

Lina: feedback loop proposal: weekly 3-question pulse; one 30m interview per customer in weeks 2 and 5; automated telemetry snapshots (p95, error rate, KV hits); collect prompt samples for offline evals.

Ana: draft recruitment filters: production inference, commit to 1hr integration, share prompt slice, fortnightly sync. Add anything?

Kevin: add infra type (cloud/VPC) and escalation contact. Tag by model family & avg seq length for rollout matrix.

Maya: draft invite copy OK but add explicit opt-out for request logs and KMS note for regulated customers.

Jonah: Legal will want the opt-out in writing. Also require clear rollback SLAs in playbook.

Ana: success criteria (draft): 
- Engagement: >=6/8 complete quickstart within 7 days
- Reliability: failure rate <0.5%
- Latency: p95 <= 1.5x customer baseline for >=90% of requests
- Quality: <=2 customer-reported major regressions during pilot
- Business: at least 3 customers willing to pilot canary on production route

Lina: add qualitative target: average pulse NPS >=6/10 and 3 interviews noting acceptable tradeoffs.

Maya: freeze major infra-impacting deploys during a wave unless rollback takes <15m. Is ops OK with that?

ops-bot: Instrumentation checklist created: token-level latency, per-request status, model-variant id, KV-cache hit rate, batch size histogram, cold-start count. Sharing rule: aggregate only unless opt-in. Alert on sustained error rate >0.5% for 10m.

Ana: recruitment channels: AE/CS warm outreach, targeted product blog signup, and past beta list. Incentives: early pricing, 3mo dedicated credits, small implementation stipend, co-marketing (explicit sign-off required).

Kevin: I'll own SDK samples + perf baseline script.

Maya: I'll own onboarding UX copy + consent language.

Jonah: CS will own 30-day playbook + escalation matrix.

Lina: I'll post interview guide and pulse survey by EOD Thu.

Ana: I'll draft invite email + shortscreen form and schedule Fri 11am to finalize wave1 invites. Please RSVP. End thread.
